1.explanation: We import Prettier’s API, include the built-in pipeline operator syntax plugin, and call prettier.format with pipelineProposal set to "smart". In v1.17.1, feeding the "#" placeholder triggers a SyntaxError because only the minimal proposal is implemented. Switching pipelineProposal to "minimal" (and removing “#”) demonstrates that the minimal pipeline alone is supported.
1.bug_scenario: When using Prettier v1.17.1 with the “smart” (or future “fsharp”) pipeline operator proposal enabled, parsing expressions that use the “#” placeholder (smart‐pipeline syntax) fails with a SyntaxError. Only the minimal pipeline (no “#”) is actually supported in this version.
